failure.summary: At step 77 the terminal wedged in the middle of a long `cat > /tmp/ext.py << 'PYEOF'` heredoc (screen frozen at 's = socket.socket(soc'); from steps 78-223 (147 of 224 steps) every observation is the same frozen frame despite repeated PYEOF, Ctrl-C, Ctrl-D and `tmux kill-pane`. The agent never regained the shell, made no further progress, and hit the 7200 s timeout; the grader then found no /tmp/frame.bmp.

evidence_quotes.quote:
cat > /tmp/ext.py << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess, time, struct, socket, sys
... proc = subprocess.Popen(['qemu-mipsel', '-g', '12355', '/app/doomgeneric_mips'], ...)

candidates.why_relevant: It covers exactly this symptom - 'the prompt does not return', bound the command with timeout, send Ctrl-C / tmux send-keys, never assume the shell recovered. The agent improvised those actions but the terminal never answered.

pending_relevant.why_relevant: Pending card on commands that never return: capture output, diagnose, verify the tool actually runs again; would have prescribed re-checking the shell with a marker command before continuing, which would have exposed the dead terminal earlier.

skill_use.detail: Only the input-inspection card was opened. The relevant timeout/terminal-recovery card was never opened; the model did independently try Ctrl-C, Ctrl-D, tmux send-keys and kill-pane (steps 150-219), all of which failed to revive the session.

verdict.rationale: After step 77 the sandbox terminal stopped responding for 147 consecutive steps (steps 77-223 contain only 5 distinct observations) regardless of EOF, Ctrl-C or tmux commands, so no further work was possible and the trial could only time out.
